content.text:
**Finding: compliant** (rule LD — liquidated damages/penalties payable by Customer).

- No Customer-payable liquidated damages, penalty, or early-termination/minimum-on-termination fee appears anywhere in the Agreement; searches for "liquidated damages", "penalty", "early termination" and "termination fee" surfaced nothing adverse.
- The only "penalty" reference (§ 27.3) is in our favour — termination without penalty plus refund of prepaid Fees.
- § 7.3 bars interest on amounts ultimately found not due; § 22.2 audit shortfall/cost recovery is compensatory, not a stipulated penalty.
- § 2.1 take-or-pay is the nearest economic exposure but is a minimum-volume commitment handled under the minimum-commitment rule; not double-flagged here.

No redline proposed.
